sources.citation: Magnum "ME-AGS-S Wiring Diagram for Honda (EU3000is)" 11-8-2011, https://www.magnum-dimensions.com/sites/default/files/MagAGS/ME-AGS-S-Honda-EU3000is-Rev-11-08-2011.pdf (sold as a harness by Pinellas, https://www.pinellaspowerproducts.com/product/honda-eu3000is-to-magnum-ags-harness-kit/) (checked: 2026-09-01)

transport: 3-wire momentary START + maintained RUN via three 30 A SPDT relays onto the Honda combination switch (FS/ST/BAT/E/IG) · voltages ? (switch carries battery +12 V; 5 A fuse shown) · no kit choke.

models.name: EU3000is
models.notes: "has a manual choke and may not automatically start if the engine is cold"

gotchas: Timing: 10 s crank, 2 min between, 4 attempts. Honda OM p34 limits cranking to 5 s.
Not a dry-contact input on the generator — the controller must pulse the ST relay and hold/ground the IG circuit itself. Not suitable for an unattended cold site by Magnum's own note.
